scope: Synthetic local deposit rechecks; no provider/model/network calls
shapes: Both supported example countries, five principal multipliers per example; original dated receipts cloned to distinct owners/ids
writer_probe: One independent Store writer started at completion entry during each load; SQLite busy timeout 5000ms
interpretation: Changed-rate monolithic writes exhausted the 5-second competing writer timeout. Both bounded-batch cases permit the competing writer; dataset ingestion remains atomic, and each 200-decision checkpoint commits with its immutable receipts. Total throughput is lower in exchange for bounded lock occupancy. This is one local run per scenario, not a production capacity claim.
